title: Accounts Receivable | Business Operations | BackOfficeFleet
description: BOF accounts receivable support connects invoice aging, disputes, customer packet support, factoring context, and owner follow-up.
html:
Business Operations / Accounts Receivable

Show why money is still open.

AR follow-up improves when the office can see whether an invoice is aging normally, missing proof, disputed, waiting on customer approval, tied to a claim, or blocked by factoring packet support.

Business OperationsCustomer Billing

AR manager lens

Aging without reason creates noise.

BOF connects receivables to packet status, customer follow-up, owner queue, and next review date.

Receivable view

The office needs to know why money is still open.

BOF gives receivable follow-up operating context without pretending to be a lender, bank, factor, or accounting firm.

Aging and owner

Track the age of open items, the assigned owner, the customer contact path, and the next review date.

Dispute context

Show whether a dispute is about missing proof, detention, accessorial approval, claim evidence, or rate support.

Factoring packet context

Surface packet readiness and missing items that may affect factoring coordination or cash-flow follow-through.

Leadership visibility

Summarize open receivables by reason, owner, customer, aging bucket, and operating record.

Aging and dispute control

Separate normal aging from fixable blockers.

Classify open AR by customer, invoice, packet status, dispute reason, factoring context, owner, and next action.
